name: You See Girls
source:
Welcome to UCJJ! I’m Mio, and I’ll be your tour guide and Resident Assistant for the summer you’ll be spending here. Even though it’s a summer school full of expectations, work, and decisions, it’s also a summer school with cute girls! They all hail from different regions, so make sure you spend some time getting to know them. I bet this school is different from anything you’ve experienced in Japan. Finding a special someone at this school isn’t going to be easy, especially since they all have their personal schedules. So what are you going to do this summer? If you work hard enough, maybe you’ll garner the attention of a certain girl… but from who?

[From [url=https://am000zing.itch.io/you-see-girls]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到UCJJ！我是澪，我将担任你在这里度过的夏天的导游和驻场助理。虽然这是一个充满期待、工作和决定的暑期学校，但这也是一个有可爱女孩的暑期学校！他们都来自不同的地区，所以一定要花一些时间来了解他们。我敢打赌这所学校与你在日本经历过的任何学校都不一样。在这所学校找到一个特别的人并不容易，尤其是因为他们都有自己的个人日程安排。那么这个夏天你打算做什么？如果你足够努力，也许你会引起某个女孩的注意……但是来自谁呢？

[来自[url=https://am000zing.itch.io/you-see-girls]itch.io[/url]]
